english.title: Employer undertake demolition / maintenance work exposing employee to asbestos
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employer, undertook work in respect of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), in

(A)_[demolition]_
(B)_[maintenance]_
(C)_[**(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE WORK..)]_

which

(D)_[exposed]_
(E)_[was liable to expose]_

your employees to asbestos, otherwise than in circumstances outlined in regulation 5(a) or 5(b) of the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 5 of the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 and section 33(1)(c) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
employer undertake work
in demolition / maintenance / other work
exposing / liable to expose
employees to asbestos in respect those premises

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) These Regulations apply to any work outside Great Britain to which sections 1 to 59 and 80 to 82 of the Health and Safety at Work Act etc 1974 Act apply by virtue of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974 (Application Outside Great Britain) Order 2001 as they apply to work in Great Britain.
(ii) There is no offence under Regulation 5 of the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 where: (a) that employer has carried out a suitable and sufficient assessment as to whether asbestos, what type of asbestos, contained in what material and in what condition is present or is liable to be present in those premises; or (b) if there is doubt as to whether asbestos is present in those premises, that employer (i) assumes that asbestos is present, and that it is not chrysotile alone, and (ii) observes the applicable provisions of these Regulations.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Note: In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (general limit on magistrates' court's powers to imprison), a reference to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months is to be read as a reference to imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months.
